prompt: A small number of global streaming companies now decide which films and television series are made. Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In the recent years, the entertainment industry has changed a lot and now only the few big streaming companies like Netflix are deciding which movies and the series will be made. Some people think it is good and some think it is bad. In my view, this development is more negative.

On the one hand, there are the certain advantages. These companies are having a lot of the money, so they can make the big budget shows with the good quality. Also, they are making the content in many languages and the people from all over the world can watch it, for example the Korean and the Spanish shows are becoming popular everywhere. Before this, it was very difficult for a small country to show their films in the foreign countries.

On the other hand, the main problem is that only the few companies are taking all the decisions. If they are thinking that a topic is not popular, then that film will never be made, and the new directors are not getting the chance. Also, these companies are only looking at the data and the numbers, so they are making the same type of the shows again and again, and the creativity is suffering. The audience is also getting bored with the same content.

In conclusion, although the streaming companies are giving the good quality and the international content, I believe this development is more negative because the power is in the hands of the very few people and the variety is decreasing.
title: A few streaming companies choosing what gets made
